author: Zephyr I
title: Replicate (fixed2) BASE_SEED=7 — d=6 Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM + Late Time Inj., br=0.28 (AdamW+clip)
abstract: Exact architecture replicate of the micro-sweep winners: bottleneck-dilated CNN (d=6, br=0.28) + Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM + late dual-head pooling (Attn ⊕ GAP) with late time injection; AdamW+clip; BASE_SEED=7.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

BASE_SEED = 7

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    dilation: int = 6
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int,int] = (3,3)
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)  # per-pixel LN over channels
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

class DoubleStepCell(nn.Module):
    features: int
    def setup(self):
        self.cell = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.features)
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        (h1, c1), _ = self.cell(carry, x)
        (h2, c2), y2 = self.cell((h1, c1), x)
        return (h2, c2), y2

class LateDualHead_DoubleStep_LNConvLSTM(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    dilation: int = 6
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28

    def setup(self):
        self.ds = DoubleStepCell(self.conv_lstm_features)

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        # Late time injection: extract scalar time from raw input (channel 7)
        t_map = x[..., 7:8] if x.shape[-1] >= 8 else jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, 1), dtype=x.dtype)
        t_scalar = t_map.mean(axis=(1,2,3))  # (B,)

        # CNN backbone with dilated bottlenecks
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2,
                                   bottleneck_ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio,
                                   dilation=self.dilation)(x)

        # Init/reset recurrent state
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        # Double-step LN-ConvLSTM (shared weights across two internal steps)
        (h_new, c_new), h_out = self.ds((rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']), x)
        rnn_state = {'h': h_new, 'c': c_new}

        # Late dual-head pooling (Attn ⊕ GAP), then late time concatenation
        B_, H, W, C = h_out.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(h_out).reshape((B_, H*W))
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_, H*W, 1))
        tokens = h_out.reshape((B_, H*W, C))
        attn_vec = (attn_weights * tokens).sum(axis=1)  # (B, C)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1)                   # (B, C)
        z = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec, t_scalar[:, None]], axis=-1)  # (B, 2C+1)

        # Heads
        z = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); z = nn.relu(z)
        pol_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); pol_h = nn.relu(pol_h)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(pol_h)
        val_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); val_h = nn.relu(val_h)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(val_h).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return LateDualHead_DoubleStep_LNConvLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        dilation=int(hparams['dilation']),
        bottleneck_ratio=float(hparams['bottleneck_ratio']),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=1e-4),
    )
